current.text: He is a projected Lakers starter, next to Doncic, Reaves, Grimes and Kessler.
His starting spot is not secure. LaRavia could start instead, and Ziaire Williams might also start.
He may be the perfect fit next to Doncic and Reaves. His size is a concern, and the spot may rotate.
He may not handle more than 22 minutes a game.
He is mostly a pick for 16 to 20 team leagues. He has big value for teams that punt points.
The Lakers have the second most back-to-backs in the league. Experts warn that soft tissue injuries could become a problem.
The Lakers play 3, 4 and 3 games in our playoff weeks with the March 28 end. That puts them in the bottom half of the league.

durable.text: He has very high steal and deflection rates. His steal rate is higher than Dyson Daniels'.
He would lead the league in steals if he played 30 minutes a game.
Experts say he has blocked shots well for a wing in the past.
He keeps having knee injuries and has also had ankle problems.
He has improved his corner three.
Josh says he does not bring shooting upside.
Almost all his value is in steals. He scores and rebounds very little for his position.

note: Both sites value him at 0 USD (Yahoo rank 343, ESPN rank 220), and he was not drafted in our league last season. With only 144 players drafted, he is not a target in our 12-team league. He fits teams that punt points or rebounds and want a cheap source of steals (1.9 projected per game), so watch him on waivers. Early in the season, check whether he keeps the starting job over LaRavia and Ziaire Williams, whether his minutes go above 22, and how his knees hold up on the Lakers' many back-to-backs.
